content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in how to handle Modbus registers that have a length greater than 1 when reading from a remote device. Reading a value with a length of 1 works, but I encounter issues when the length is more than 1. I attempted a Modbus connection data transfer by selecting 2 words, but this approach did not work, nor did reading a single word through that method. However, using the network analog input and selecting 'Read value from remote device' works fine for reading a single word.
When using an analog network input, you can only read a 16-bit variable (1 register); reading 32-bit values (2 consecutive registers) is not supported.
Please specify exactly what you want to read, and share the register table of the remote device.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having difficulty reading Modbus registers with a length greater than one word from a remote device. They report success with reading single 16-bit values, but not with longer registers. Others clarify that the current approach only supports reading 16-bit variables via the analog network input, indicating the product does not support multi-register reads in this context.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to read values spanning multiple Modbus registers (beyond 16-bit) from a remote device using the same method as for single-register values.
